blockers.detail: the gas 'notes' obstack is no longer initialised by read_begin(); main() must call obstack_begin(&notes, chunksize) before the init/begin functions
H0 re-implements main()'s init sequence (symbol_begin, frag_init, subsegs_begin, read_begin, ...) and relies on read_begin() establishing the notes obstack; it never calls obstack_begin(&notes)

rationale.zh: fuzz_as 绕过 main()，自己按顺序组合调用 gas 的各个 init/begin 函数，依赖『read_begin 会建立 notes obstack』这一状态约定。M（gas: set up notes obstack earlier）把 obstack_begin(&notes) 从 read_begin 移到 main，harness 组合出的状态缺少 notes，首次分配段信息即跳到空函数指针 SEGV。S0 正常，故本次引入。H（oss-fuzz #9400，注明 upstream gas has changed / issue 48997）在 harness 中补上 obstack_begin(&notes) 等初始化。注：该例也可视为 lifecycle（初始化顺序）；按『组合调用依赖的状态约定』归为 state。
rationale.en: fuzz_as bypasses main() and calls the gas init/begin functions itself in a fixed order, relying on the state convention that read_begin() sets up the notes obstack. M (gas: set up notes obstack earlier) moves obstack_begin(&notes) from read_begin() into main(), so the state built by the harness has no notes obstack and the first section-info allocation jumps through a null function pointer (SEGV). The harness works with S0 (M^1), so the degradation is introduced by this change. H (oss-fuzz #9400, which cites "upstream gas has changed" and issue 48997) adds obstack_begin(&notes) and other initialisation to the harness. Note: the case could also be read as lifecycle (initialisation order); it is labelled state because it is about a state convention that the composed calls rely on.
